summary: casecheck refuses the forwards of a machine's cards that the QEMU launcher would refuse, and those of a guest case's cards

argv: exec ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -O1 -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I tools/etude -I tools/etude/include -I utils tools/etude/casecheck.c ${SRC}/tools/etude/cases.c tools/etude/digest.c tools/etude/judge.c tools/etude/json.c tools/etude/processor.c tools/etude/qemu_profile.c tools/etude/schema.c tools/etude/verdict.c tools/etude/history.c tools/etude/history_json.c utils/sha256.c -o ${WORK}/casecheck

faults.name: past-taken
faults.summary: a forward of a port past those the case reserves is taken

faults.name: twice-taken
faults.summary: a local port forwarded twice by one protocol is taken

faults.name: protocol-ignored
faults.summary: a local port forwarded by TCP and by UDP is taken for one forwarded twice

faults.name: guest-boot-taken
faults.summary: forwards of a card of a guest case's boot are taken
